title: Backup exclusion assertion also accepts include rules

observed: Red: all five negative fixtures fail because the old predicate throws nothing; three original tests pass (8 total). Green: all 10 final methods pass with 0 failures and 0 skips. Current production XML was never changed.
fix: Shared assertion parses XML with DocumentBuilderFactory and uses absolute XPath for both data-extraction parents and legacy root; domain and path must belong to the same direct exclude child.
